WITNESS STATEMENT
Name: Samuel Kiprono
Occupation: Driver, Baraka Haulage Ltd

On 19th May 2025 I was driving KDH 418Q from
Nakuru to Kisumu with 600 bags of cement.
Near Kipsitet at about 4.30 am the road was wet
and a matatu overtook from the opposite side.
I swerved to avoid it and the truck overturned.
The cargo was lost and some was taken by people
who came to the scene. I reported at the police
station the same morning. I was not injured.

I make this statement believing it to be true.

Signed: ____________   Date: 21/05/2025
